body:

Body **r44** (R3 dispatched: #23768, #23753; PRs #23751 and #23766 PASS, held only by `skip-changeset`), written 2026-10-16T02:25Z by `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7` (os-elon-musk); r43, r42, r41, r40, r39, r38, r37, r36, r35, r34, r33 (seating) and r32 (the previous shift's sign-off ledger, `session_012dGTuJen61ECNHXYXKChoC`, os-justin) are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

🟢 **os-elon-musk** — `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7`, seated on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills seat 2` in this session; the round-open marker is the comment stamped after this body. Default wake-up Routine `trig_0146Bbf4fhg7HqoFCFCYGvWw` (hourly at :16, self-bound to this session). Batch **3** (the seating default; no maintainer word on concurrency in this session). Seat 1 (#7623) reads ⏳ vacant since its sign-off around 12:29Z, so this is the lane's only seated PM. Each card's newest `Claim:` `Seat:` line says whose it is.

## Inherited + running ledger

- **Lane now** (objectstack; objectui 0 open `domain:skills`): `pm:queue` 1.
  - #23770 (p3, `bug`, filed and self-triaged by this seat): `os-dev.md` L295 「⛔ 不抬 ceiling」 against ruling 6184799323 B item 1. It is serial behind PR #23766, which edits the same file.

- **This seat's cards (R1):**
  - #23615 — **landed**: PR #23669 `547702080`, Tier H, approved and enqueued by `os-zhuang` before the at-tier review could run (tier at its usage limit); landing comment 6192063883.

  - Both landing strokes ran on the maintainer's 「同意你复核落地」 in this session, after the classifier refusals (6202646278, 6202691212).
  - #23606 was lost to seat 1 (yield note on the card).

  - #23733 — PR #23751: ACCEPT 6204912477, at-tier PASS 6205062630 on `5629c6ff6`.
  - #23665 — PR #23766: ACCEPT 6205486800, at-tier PASS 6205619558 on `5e548689e`. The `os-dev.md` ceiling rises 402 → 404 under 6184799323 B, quoting 6190922830.

  - Open questions for the maintainer, non-blocking, on the cards:
    - `yes (narrowing)` → the narrowing face? (#23692, 6205078148)
    - first-touch labels for 例外二 cards? (#23733, 6205096053)

  - #23753 (p2, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`, Tier H). Unlocked at 6206342342 when PR #23747 merged. Claim 6206601975, order 6206628224; `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` build (MANDATORY, `skills/**`).
- **In flight 2** (#23768, #23753) · **Landing windows 2** (PRs #23751 and #23766, waiting on the maintainer's word) · **decision box 0**. Posture: collecting.

## Notes

- **Write paths:** content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`issue_patch` for this post's title and PR bodies); route `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`); ⛔ no MCP write.
- **Harness:** CURRENT at `0a168a33e`. The shared checkout was fast-forwarded `--ff-only` at each round boundary: `57994c311` → `3b46855fb` → `1ac24f2f8` → `0a168a33e`. The four-axis block's md5 is unchanged (`abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`).
- **Served tier:** `get_session` `last_served_model` is the `TIER_DEFAULT` build ⇒ at-tier contract reviews run in an isolated at-tier subagent; ⛔ no self-review above the seat's tier. The seven-day quota reads `allowed_warning`.
- **Quota wall ended.** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` refused this session from 12:03Z to 20:18Z (twelve HTTP 429s). It answered after the 21:00Z reset, and both at-tier reviews PASSed. The reviewer transcripts carry 57 and 67 at-tier stamps and 0 at any other tier.
- **Classifier refusal, resolved.** The Tier S landing strokes were refused at 2026-10-15T21:27Z (`Merge Without Review`, `CI Bypass`), and the seat stopped and reported. The maintainer answered 「同意你复核落地」 in this session, and the same commands then ran (relay run 38819636530). Both PRs merged by the queue at 2026-10-15T23:06Z.
- **Carried for the shift brief** (not cards, under the filing gate):
  - **Platform fact:** `references/platform-readings.md` L171 documents the single-issue page payload as `payload.preloadedQueries[0].result.data.repository.issue` with `frontTimelineItems`. Measured live by the #23615 dev and by the seat 2026-10-15T11:59Z: the `react-app.embeddedData` block carrying `bodyHTML` holds `payload.issueViewerRoute.data.repository.issue`, with `timelineItems` / `backTimelineItems`.
  - **Principle:** `SKILL.md` L265 「…四轴冲突时其余各轴合起来投不翻它」 names no axis-④ new-gate exception, now that `decision-analysis.md` does (PR #23675). The #23662 dev reads L266 as reconciling the two.
  - **Principle:** `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`'s report JSON template has no `deviations` key, while three of its lines (one new, from PR #23676) and the dispatch orders name one.
  - **Stale text after PR #23750:** the frozen `dispatch-gates.mjs` L12013, `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` L1062 and `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` L9961 comments say "three contract faces", and so does `references/lanes/ui.md` L38 (契约三面).
- **Timers and subscriptions:** Routine `trig_0146Bbf4fhg7HqoFCFCYGvWw`. `subscribe_pr_activity` is open on PRs #23751 and #23766; PR #23750's ended at its merge. Each further PR is subscribed the moment its report names it. Worktrees: all three R2 worktrees were removed by their devs.
